about_the_game:
Will humanity thrive or will everything turn to decay by the shape of their sins and the weight of their desires?.

After a great war where they refused to take part, humanity wants to use the blessing given to them by chance, and obliterate all the ancient civilizations wich came before them, now all hurt and debilitated. Will this timing be enough or are they underestimating the ancient knowldge and power they left behing and have now forgotten.

Carry the aspirations of humanity in this fast paced combat focused game.                        Learn to use the soul binding system to maximaze  your combat proficiency.                Discover every hidden place in a world where you'll find optional enemies and gems awaiting for you.

Play a different game look with the Soul Seeker mode!

Notes:

As this page is published the game is still on development, with yet some road to walk, because of the lack of team members and budget. A lot of time, effort and love is being put into the development process, this though won't be really fast paced, and any kind of new announcement will be made only when a considerable step is given.

CO-OP is planned in both forms, on and offline for the campaign, also for the alternative mode Soul Treasure, PvP is planned too on the last mentioned.

Every teaser and, or trailer will use in engine capture only, no cgi nor postproduction enhancements, as the objective is to depict the true escence of the game.

It's planned to avoid any kind of DRM or Anti Cheat.

This game have planned two future free DLCS, one in the form of a campaign mode expantion and the second one as aditional content in the "Soul Treasure" (Colliseum) mode. Though, this two will depend on the future development state. For any kind of announcements related please check up the announces scetion, wich you can find in the part above.

Love BRD.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violent content wich come from fighting fantastic enemies

name: Ozymandias: Last Strive
short_description: Prepare to fight in this game where every enemy is stronger than you and always have a hidden card to use. Only your sword, wit, quick movements and your guts need to be enough for you to survive and reach greatness, you'll travel to surreal places, fighting to achieve a questionable win. Unveil it.
